title: farsetia lunarioides
intro: Farsetia lunarioides, commonly known as Lunaria, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use in treating fever, inflammation, and various gastrointestinal issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Farsetia lunarioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
